annotation.purpose: Caveat margin notes only: short, lowercase, tilted.

shadows.purpose: Hover state of an interactive sticker.

shadows.name: soft-lifted

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default CSS easing for colour changes and scroll reveals.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Sticker press: sinks 2px into its shadow; the shadow shrinks to match.

motion.name: release-spring
motion.purpose: Springy return after press and hover (springy touch feel confirmed by the user).

motion.name: pin-up-spring
motion.value: spring, duration 0.45s, bounce 0.3; 60ms stagger per column
motion.purpose: Art frames dropping onto the wall as they scroll into view.

motion.name: lightbox-flight
motion.value: open spring 0.45s bounce 0.15; close spring 0.3s bounce 0; Escape instant
motion.purpose: Shared-element flight of an art frame into and out of the lightbox.

motion.name: hero-sketch
motion.value: GSAP timeline, about 1.1s: note write-on 0.45s, portrait slap 0.5s back.out(1.6), squiggle draw 0.6s, sticker stick-on 0.45s back.out(2.2), sparkle outline 0.4s then fill
motion.purpose: The homepage's one authored entrance; text and buttons are visible from the first frame.

motion.name: margin-note-write
motion.purpose: Handwritten notes write themselves on the first time they scroll into view.

motion.name: line-boil
motion.purpose: Hand-drawn-animation shimmer on doodles while on screen; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-time scroll reveal of blocks; fade-only under reduced motion.

motion.name: bob
motion.purpose: Ambient float on sparkle doodles; disabled under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The site is a maker's studio rendered in warm, earthy materials: kraft paper underfoot, graphite pencil lines, fired-clay accents, and finished work pinned up as thick-bordered stickers. It should feel like being welcomed into someone's workspace, warm and unhurried, while everything on the walls quietly proves the person ships. The hand-made layer (pencil-grain doodles, margin notes in handwriting, pieces set slightly askew) carries the warmth; the clean grotesque type, steady grid and consistent sticker system carry the confidence. The two never trade places: handwriting annotates, it never headlines.

Density is relaxed. Sections breathe inside a 1200px container, one idea per section, and colour is spent sparingly against a large field of paper so that the crayon accents read as deliberate marks rather than decoration. Depth is physical, not atmospheric: things are either flat paper or a sticker stuck on top of it, and the hard ink shadow says which.

The system is light-first with a full dark variant ("night studio"): the paper turns to graphite, the ink outline turns to paper, and every crayon steps one shade lighter so it keeps its voice on the dark ground.
keyCharacteristics: Warm clay neutrals end to end; no cool greys and no pure black.
Three crayon accents (brick, yellow, moss) that rotate across siblings, with brick as the lead voice.
Thick ink-outlined stickers with hard offset shadows for anything touchable or showcased.
Hand-drawn SVG doodles with a pencil-grain filter (sparkles, squiggle underlines).
Short lowercase Caveat margin notes, tilted 1–2.5°, sitting above Bricolage headings.
Springy, tactile touch feedback; slow, calm ambient motion.

rules.name: The Three Crayons Rule
rules.body: Sibling cards cycle brick → yellow → moss, in that order, through their tags and icon wells. Two neighbours never share a crayon.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Every dark mark (text, outlines, shadows) is a warm clay brown. Pure black (#000) and neutral grey never appear; shadows are tinted rgba(64, 45, 24, …).

rules.name: The Margin Note Rule
rules.body: Caveat is used only for short lowercase notes (roughly six words or fewer), tilted −1° to −2.5°, usually ending in an em dash, placed directly above or beside a Bricolage heading. It is never a heading, a button label or body copy.

rules.name: The Workbench Label Rule
rules.body: Anything that is metadata (dates, places, counts, status) is set in Space Mono at label size. Prose is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Sticker Lift Rule
rules.body: A hard ink offset means "stuck on and touchable." On hover a sticker lifts (cards −2px, −3px; buttons −1px, −1px) and its shadow grows by the same amount; on press it sinks 2px into its shadow while the shadow shrinks to match, so the shadow's outer edge never moves. Blurred shadows are never put on a sticker, and ink offsets are never put on plain paper.

rules.name: The Askew Rule
rules.body: Only pinned things tilt: stickers, notes, frames and annotations, by no more than 3°. Layout containers, text blocks and controls are always square to the grid.

dos: Do keep every dark mark warm: Ink Outline (#322C21) and Graphite (#241F18), shadows tinted rgba(64, 45, 24, …).
Do give anything clickable or showcased the full sticker treatment: 2.5px Ink Outline plus a hard offset shadow (4px 4px 0, or 3px 3px 0 for small parts).
Do rotate crayon tones across siblings brick → yellow → moss.
Do pair every Caveat margin note with a real Bricolage heading or Hanken statement that carries the meaning on its own.
Do run hand-drawn SVG marks through the pencil-grain filter so they never look plotter-clean.
donts: Don't use pure black, cool greys or blue-tinted neutrals anywhere.
Don't put blurred drop shadows on stickers, or hard ink offsets on plain paper surfaces.
Don't use Caveat for headings, buttons, long sentences or anything a visitor must read to act.
Don't tilt layout containers, text blocks or controls; only pinned things are askew, and never past 3°.
Don't introduce a fourth accent hue; new needs are met with washes and deeps of the three crayons.
